welcome.title: Never settle for less.
welcome.body: A new line every day for the moments you'd rather stay comfortable.

struggles.title: What's hitting hardest right now?
struggles.body: Be honest. It shapes your daily missions.

tone.title: How do you want it?
tone.lockScreen: Keep my lock screen and reminders clean
tone.lockScreenBody: People see your lock screen. We'll only put clean lines there.

reminders.title: When should we check on you?

theme.title: Pick your look.

notifications.title: Let us check on you.
notifications.body: Your lines, inside the window you picked. Turn them off anytime.

rank.title: Everyone starts SETTLED.
rank.body: Show up, knock out missions, earn XP, rank up. Higher ranks unlock the occasional UNSETLD perk. You can't buy rank. Not even with Premium.
